today_in_history_posts.title: Time to lower minrelaytxfee ?
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Five years ago, Bitcoin trading fees were dropped from 5000 to 1000 sat/vkB.
- To match previous reductions, a new cut to 22 sat/vkB was suggested.
- Recent proposals aimed to lower fees further, enhancing Lightning Network growth.

today_in_history_posts.title: Dynamic Commitments: Upgrading Channels Without On-Chain Transactions
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Rusty introduces a dual opt-in with `commit_switch` and `commit_switch_reply`.
- He suggests a hierarchical channel type system with progressive preference for newer types.
- Upgrades incorporate feature matching and require a feature bit for final implementation.

today_in_history_posts.title: Thoughts on scaling and consensus changes (2023)
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Bitcoin's scalability involves creating 50,000 off-chain "bitcoin banks" for daily transactions.  - These entities, similar to community banks, would interconnect and manage liquidity and security.  - Strategies for handling Bitcoin scalability include Layer 2 protocols and market-driven regulatory compliance.
